product_overview: AI Agency Operating System is a frontend workspace for agency teams to manage sales, delivery, billing, and client operations from a single dashboard. It provides proposal, contract, invoice, CRM, project, Jira, and settings workflows in one web app.
core_goals: Explore the product and understand its value proposition
Review agency performance through an executive dashboard
Generate client proposals from project requirements
Create contracts and e-signature links for client agreements
Manage client records and project delivery status
Review Jira sprint and issue progress

features.name: Landing Page Navigation & CTAs
features.description: Visitors learn the product value proposition, review pricing and feature information, and navigate into the workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through features, pricing, and testimonial sections -> Click Get Started / Launch Workspace button -> See the dashboard
Navigate to / -> Review pricing plans -> Click Get Started / Launch Workspace button -> See the dashboard

features.name: Executive Dashboard Overview
features.description: Users view high-level agency metrics, revenue indicators, client growth, and active project status in a single overview.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View KPI summary cards -> Inspect visual charts and project progress bars
Navigate to /dashboard -> Review monthly recurring revenue and active project metrics -> Observe overall agency performance summary

features.name: AI Proposal Generator
features.description: Users create tailored client proposals by entering project details and reviewing the generated proposal preview.
user_flows: Navigate to /proposals -> Enter client name, project scope, budget, and delivery timeline -> Generate the proposal -> Review the generated preview text
Navigate to /proposals -> Enter project requirements with budget and timeline -> Generate the proposal -> Review the proposal draft for completeness

features.name: AI Contract & MSA Builder
features.description: Users generate customized client agreements with selected legal options and obtain an e-signature link.
user_flows: Navigate to /contracts -> Select contract agreement type and IP ownership options -> Generate the contract -> Copy or download the e-signature link
Navigate to /contracts -> Choose agreement terms -> Generate the contract -> Review the contract summary and signature link

features.name: AI Invoice & Stripe Billing Builder
features.description: Users create itemized invoices with line items, tax calculations, and a final total before sending them.
user_flows: Navigate to /invoices -> Enter client name and invoice item details -> Add line items with quantity and unit price -> Create and send the invoice
Navigate to /invoices -> Fill in billing details and multiple line items -> Review subtotal, tax rate, and final total -> Create and send the invoice

features.name: Client CRM Directory
features.description: Users browse, search, and filter client records and open client cards to review project-related details.
user_flows: Navigate to /clients -> View the client directory list -> Filter or search clients by name or status -> Open a client card to view project details
Navigate to /clients -> Search for a client record -> Review matching client status and contact information -> Open the selected client card

features.name: Project Milestone Tracker
features.description: Users monitor active projects, delivery status, milestones, team assignments, budgets, and deadlines.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> View active project status cards -> Filter projects by status -> Review milestone progress and team assignments
Navigate to /projects -> Switch between project status groups -> Inspect budget consumption and deadline dates

features.name: Jira Integration Dashboard
features.description: Users review synced sprint metrics and ticket distribution, and refresh sprint status updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /jira -> View sprint metrics and ticket distribution -> Review epic progress and issue counts
Navigate to /jira -> View sprint board summary -> Sync sprint status updates -> Observe updated sprint information

features.name: Agency Settings & Preferences
features.description: Users update agency profile details, notifications, API credentials, and team role preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Update agency profile information -> Toggle notification settings and API credentials -> Save the updated preferences
Navigate to /settings -> Review team role and integration settings -> Change configuration values -> Observe the updated agency settings summary

routes.description: Public landing page showcasing AI Agency OS features, capabilities, and pricing
Executive dashboard overview displaying agency KPIs, active projects, revenue, and metrics
AI Proposal generator wizard to generate client project proposals
AI Contract & MSA Builder with legal terms and electronic signature links
AI Invoice & Stripe Billing Builder for managing line items, taxes, and client invoicing
Client directory and CRM management portal
Active projects tracker with status, milestone timelines, and team assignments
Jira and Agile workflow integration overview
